fixes.explanation: Yes, fought is the word. Joshua tells them, “…it was the LORD your God who fought for you.” (Joshua 23:3) Later he says, “One of you can put a thousand to flight, because the LORD your God fights for you…” (Joshua 23:10) Joshua points them to the LORD as the one fighting for them, so he's the one to thank.

Rebuilding is a good word, but it isn't in this verse. Joshua says the LORD will push those nations out and drive them out so Israel can take possession of their land (Joshua 23:5). The word for the blank is possess. Rebuilding comes after you own the place, and Joshua's talking about the part before that. I'd rebuild my bakery too if I got the keys, but first I'd need to get the keys.
